title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Amount Paid Up Front on a Payment Arrangement
content:
**Arrangement terms.** For a payment arrangement on a past-due Repair and Emergency Service Calls balance, part of the balance may be paid up front with the first installment. It depends on the customer's Comfort Club agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements and on how its dues have been paid. The records read are the agreement's status, the dues payment entries on its dues ledger paid by bank autopay, and the call's invoice lines.

**What is paid up front.**

| Customer | Dues drafted by bank autopay in the last 12 months | Amount paid up front |
|---|---|---|
| Active agreement | None | The call's late-payment charges, together with its diagnostic fee and after-hours premium net of the member diagnostic rate and member premium discount (that net amount never below zero) |
| Active agreement | One or more | The call's late-payment charges alone |
| No active agreement | — | Nothing; the whole balance is divided equally |

**How it enters the first installment.** The amount paid up front is set aside from the balance owing when the first installment is paid. The rest is divided by the number of installments. The first installment is the amount paid up front plus one such share, rounded to the cent half up.

## Worked example (hypothetical member call, 3 installments)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Balance owing | $900.00 |
| Late-payment charges on the call | $13.50 |
| Diagnostic fee and after-hours premium | $89.00 and $99.00 |
| Member diagnostic rate and member premium discount | $40.00 and $49.50 |
| Net fees | $98.50 |
| Paid up front (no autopay drafts in 12 months) | $13.50 and $98.50, which is $112.00 |
| Rest divided by 3 | $788.00 divided by 3, which is $262.666…, rounded to $262.67 |
| First installment | $112.00 and $262.67, which is $374.67 |

Had the member's dues been drafted by bank autopay in the last 12 months, $13.50 would be paid up front. The share would be $886.50 divided by 3, which is $295.50, and the first installment $309.00.
